_doc: The resonance/conversion-quality eval rubric (S2.2 Marketing domain, SP-20260530-001). The named UNDER-BUILD fix (FINAL-PLAN §10d): MC checks correctness but NOT message clarity, proof strength, audience specificity, visual hierarchy, objection handling, or conversion hypothesis — without these it ships valid artifacts that still feel generic. This rubric makes those six dimensions REAL: each carries explicit PASS / FAIL criteria, a weight, and where possible a mechanical check. It is a JUDGMENT eval (most dimensions require a judging agent — Director of Marketing / Copy Lead / Web-Conversion-Designer / Research-Insight Lead reading the artifact against its briefs); the mechanical sub-checks are the fail-closed floor, not the whole bar. Owned by Marketing; consumed by the growth: pack (advertorial · landing-page · ad-images · iterate) and the Wave-3 pilot exit criteria. v0.1 REVISABLE post-pilot.

scoring.scale: 0-4 per dimension (0 absent · 1 token · 2 weak · 3 solid · 4 excellent)
scoring.overall_rule: An artifact PASSES only if EVERY required dimension scores >= 3 AND no dimension hard-fails its mechanical floor. A weighted average alone does NOT pass — a single generic-feeling dimension (e.g. score 1 on proof strength) fails the artifact even if the weighted mean is high. This is the anti-'valid-but-generic' rule: no compensating away a hollow dimension.
scoring.fail_closed: Missing brief inputs (no audience_dossier / message_brief) => the eval CANNOT score => result = ARBITRATION-NEEDED (not PASS). An eval that can't see its grounding must never read green (false-green bug class).

judges._note: Per-dimension judge applies its owned principle. The Director of Marketing arbitrates a split or an ARBITRATION-NEEDED; β only on cross-domain conflict / ship gate.

dimensions.criteria: The single core message is unmistakable in one read; clear beats clever. A cold reader can state what is being offered and to whom after the hook alone.
dimensions.pass: Core message stated plainly up front; one idea per block; reads at ~5th-8th grade; the hero/hook carries the message_brief.core_message verbatim or unmistakably.
dimensions.fail: Buried lede; cleverness over clarity; reader can't restate the offer after the hook; hero doesn't carry the core message; jargon a cold reader wouldn't know.

checks.why: the artifact must carry the spine's core message, not a drifted one
placeholder copy is an automatic fail

dimensions.criteria: Every claim is backed by real, source-attributed proof; the argument (not power-words) carries the persuasion. No invented data.
dimensions.pass: message_brief.proof_points are concrete + source-grounded; each major claim has proof adjacent; synthetic claims labelled; argument-led (unique mechanism proven different+better).
dimensions.fail: Hype/power-word stuffing standing in for proof; claims with no source; invented statistics/quotes; proof_points empty or vague ('trusted by thousands' with no ref).

checks.why: at least one real proof point required
a numeric/statistical claim with no source ref hard-fails (no-invented-data)
ALL-CAPS runs + '!' density + 'discover the secret' class phrasing flags hype-over-argument

dimensions.criteria: Speaks to ONE named segment and its deepest emotional needs — never 'everyone'. Grounded in the audience_dossier.
dimensions.pass: Targets a named audience_dossier.segment; reflects its emotional_needs (not just functional jobs); language matches the segment's voice-of-customer.
dimensions.fail: Generic 'anyone who…'; no named segment; functional-only (ignores the emotional layer); language that could front any product in the category.

checks.why: must be built for a real, named dossier
a dossier below 0.5 confidence is too thin to claim specificity; surface as ARBITRATION-NEEDED

dimensions.criteria: The eye flows hook -> proof -> single CTA; one obvious next action; holds on mobile. (N/A for copy-only artifacts.)
dimensions.pass: One primary CTA, unmissable + repeated at decision points; hero above the fold carries the message on mobile; every element installs a belief / removes an objection; tap targets + load OK.
dimensions.fail: Competing CTAs; buried value prop; hero that doesn't carry the message; desktop-only hierarchy that breaks on mobile; decorative elements that don't move toward conversion.

checks.why: competing CTAs are a conversion leak
raw vibe-coded elements fail scan:scaffold-coverage + the design-quality gauntlet

dimensions.criteria: The prospect's real objections + limiting beliefs are surfaced and answered; necessary beliefs installed before the ask.
dimensions.pass: conversion_brief.objections_handled are real (sourced from the audience) and each is addressed in the artifact; limiting beliefs removed / empowering beliefs installed before the CTA; <=6 necessary beliefs, each 'I believe that…'.
dimensions.fail: Objections ignored or strawmanned; CTA before beliefs are installed ('the prior problem'); objections list empty; >6 beliefs or beliefs not in the required form.

checks.why: at least one real objection addressed
each necessary belief in the required 'I believe that…' form

dimensions.criteria: A falsifiable conversion hypothesis exists, ties to the message, and (for iterate/scale) is backed by real metric data — not opinion.
dimensions.pass: conversion_brief.conversion_hypothesis is explicit + testable (who does what, expected lift, against what); derives from the message_brief; for an iterate/scale decision, real metric data is attached.
dimensions.fail: No hypothesis, or an untestable one ('this will convert better'); hypothesis untethered to the message; scaling proposed on opinion with no metric data attached.

checks.why: a converting artifact must state its hypothesis
the hypothesis must trace to the spine

enforcer_note: This rubric is the DATA; its runnable enforcer is the resonance-conversion-quality eval (DESIGN in runtime/notes/wave2-s2.2-enforcers-design.md — α wires the runner). The eval REJECTS (not lints) an artifact that hard-fails any mechanical floor or scores <3 on any required dimension, and emits a decision_record (schemas/contracts/decision_record.schema.json). The mechanical sub-checks share machinery with the chiefing/no-invented-data enforcer; the judgment dimensions dispatch the per-dimension judge agent. Fail-closed: a runner error or missing brief => non-zero / ARBITRATION-NEEDED, never green (cross-provider-qa false-green guard).
